browser.storageFailure: fail closed before POST; retain unknown on acknowledgement failure
browser.acceptedRecovery: clear exact marker only; remain stopped; fresh trusted bootstrap/new Runtime/current mount required

trustedBff.originalMapping: business-owned shared durable uniqueness/CAS; scope/current subject, original Target/key and immutable prepared-request fingerprint
trustedBff.dispatch: claim unknown before one attempt; duplicate never POSTs
trustedBff.reconcile: current business auth/resource before and after I/O; original Segment/key/Session/Task/Run only; fresh native receipt even when cached accepted
trustedBff.crashBeforeDispatch: may remain unknown; no safe redispatch without future native reservation/proof
trustedBff.nativeKeyInitialDerivation: bff-request-v1: + SHA256 of scoped immutable prepared request; persist original native key, never recompute during reconciliation

verificationBoundary.businessAuth: reference Cookie/private loopback bridge and local native authority
